controls.title: Audit logging is enabled on security-relevant infrastructure
controls.objective: Security infrastructure (audit trails, CloudTrail, access logging) must remain enabled so that accountability and incident forensics are preserved.
controls.requirement_summary: Audit logging on security-relevant compute/storage infrastructure must be configured and actively enabled.
evidence_expected: Current Terraform state showing logging configuration enabled
Named procedure for reviewing audit log gaps weekly

controls.title: CloudWatch log delivery is retained for security infrastructure
controls.objective: Infrastructure changes must keep log delivery (CloudWatch log group retention) intact so that monitoring remains effective.
controls.requirement_summary: CloudWatch retention must not be dropped for security-relevant log groups.
evidence_expected: CloudWatch log group retention config evidence collected within 90 days

controls.title: Data at rest is encrypted (SSE/KMS)
controls.objective: AWS storage used for audit artifacts and business data must be encrypted at rest with customer-managed or AWS-managed keys.
controls.requirement_summary: AWS S3 buckets and EBS volumes backing audit data must retain server-side encryption configuration.
evidence_expected: Current Terraform state showing encryption configuration

controls.title: Customer-managed key rotation is attested
controls.objective: Customer-managed CMKs must rotate at least annually with independent attestation.
controls.requirement_summary: KMS CMK rotation report must be current (within 12 months).

controls.title: Least-privilege IAM permissions
controls.objective: IAM policies must grant the minimum permissions required; wildcard-literal actions or resources are permitted only with documented justification.
controls.requirement_summary: IAM policy references must not widen permissions from a scoped allowlist to a wildcard.

controls.title: Sensitive management ports are not exposed to the internet
controls.objective: Ingress rules granting 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH, RDP or database management ports are prohibited.
controls.requirement_summary: Security groups must not expose SSH/RDP/database management ports to the internet.

controls.title: Every security-critical metric has a live alarm
controls.objective: Monitoring must raise alerts for security-critical events.
controls.requirement_summary: A metric alarm must exist for each critical resource; dropping alarms is prohibited.
